ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: The constraints given by the problem are x≥0, y≥0, x+2y≤4, so the feasible region is the triangle in the first quadrant enclosed by three straight lines, with vertices (0,0), (4,0), and (0,2). Interpret z=(y+2)/(x-1) as the slope of the line connecting the feasible point (x,y) and the fixed point P=(1,-2), because the slope is (y-(-2))/(x-1)=(y+2)/(x-1). When x=1, z is undefined, so discuss the two sides x>1 and x<1 separately. If x>1, then the denominator is positive, and y+2>0, so z is positive. Drawing lines from P to the right-side part of the feasible triangle, the smallest positive slope occurs when connecting to the vertex (4,0), at which time z=(0+2)/(4-1)=2/3; when the feasible point approaches x=1 from the right side, the denominator approaches 0 positive, and z tends to +∞, so the positive value range is [2/3,+∞). If x<1, then the denominator is negative, and y+2>0, so z is negative. Drawing lines from P to the left-side part of the feasible triangle, the largest negative slope occurs when connecting to the vertex (0,0), at which time z=(0+2)/(0-1)=-2; when the feasible point approaches x=1 from the left side, the denominator approaches 0 negative, and z tends to -∞, so the negative value range is (-∞,-2]. Combining the two parts, the value range of z is (-∞,-2]∪[2/3,+∞).

method.method_draft: 几何斜率法：先从题面读出可行域为 x>=0, y>=0, x+2y<=4，即第一象限内三角形，顶点为 (0,0)、(4,0)、(0,2)。把 z=(y+2)/(x-1) 看成可行点 (x,y) 与定点 P=(1,-2) 连线的斜率。由于 x=1 时 z 无定义，分左右两侧看。从 P 向三角形右侧区域所能作出的斜率为正，最小斜率出现在连到顶点 (4,0) 时，值为 (0+2)/(4-1)=2/3；当可行点趋近直线 x=1 的右侧时，斜率趋于 +∞，所以正值范围为 [2/3,+∞)。从 P 向三角形左侧区域所能作出的斜率为负，最大负斜率出现在连到顶点 (0,0) 时，值为 (0+2)/(0-1)=-2；当可行点趋近 x=1 的左侧时，斜率趋于 -∞，所以负值范围为 (-∞,-2]。合并得到 (-∞,-2]∪[2/3,+∞)。

method.CoT_raw:
由约束 x+2y-4≤0, x≥0, y≥0 得 x+2y≤4。因为 y≥0，所以 x≤4，又 x≥0，故 0≤x≤4；同时 y+2≥2。表达式 z=(y+2)/(x-1) 在 x=1 时无定义，因此按 x>1 与 x<1 分段讨论。

当 x>1 时，由 0≤x≤4 得 0<x-1≤3，分母为正。又 y+2≥2，所以 z=(y+2)/(x-1)≥2/(x-1)≥2/3，其中等号在 x=4, y=0 时取得。反过来，对任意 t≥2/3，取 y=0, x=1+2/t，则 1<x≤4，且 x+2y=x≤4，满足约束，并且 z=2/(x-1)=t。因此正值部分的取值范围为 [2/3,+∞)。

当 x<1 时，由 0≤x≤4 得 -1≤x-1<0，分母为负。又 y+2≥2，除以负数不等号反向，得 z=(y+2)/(x-1)≤2/(x-1)≤-2，其中等号在 x=0, y=0 时取得。反过来，对任意 t≤-2，取 y=0, x=1+2/t，则 0≤x<1，满足约束，并且 z=2/(x-1)=t。因此负值部分的取值范围为 (-∞,-2]。

合并两种情况，z 的取值范围为 (-∞,-2]∪[2/3,+∞)。
